department: Wayne H. King Department of Chemical and Environmental Engineering

deadline.value: International graduate application deadline for Fall entry is June 1, 2027 (apply earlier for assistantship/fellowship consideration; financial aid priority deadline is January 15).
deadline.quote: Fall applications must be submitted by June 1

gre_general.value: Effective Summer 2024 onwards, the Frank H. Dotterweich College of Engineering does not require the GRE for graduate admissions (superseding older departmental catalog/webpage text).
gre_general.quote: effective Summer 2024 onwards | GRE: GRE is not required for admissions.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Having a faculty advisor is strongly recommended and is required for direct B.S.-to-Ph.D. entry (without a committed advisor, direct B.S. applicants are routed to/provisionally admitted via the M.S.).
supervisor.quote: Must have faculty willing to advise them; otherwise, admit them into the MS program

also.quote: Must have faculty willing to advise the student; otherwise he/she would be provisionally admitted into the Ph.D. program with a condition that they obtain a M.S. degree.

funding.value: Limited departmental teaching assistantships are available, and research assistantship support is awarded at the discretion of grant PIs or major advisors.
funding.quote: Departments may have limited teaching assistantships available to support Ph.D. students. Research assistantship funding, if any, is at the discretion of the grant Principal Investigator and/or the major advisor.

entry_route.value: Applicants may enter with an M.S. degree (63 credits) or directly with a B.S. in engineering in exceptional cases (93 credits, requiring a faculty advisor).
entry_route.quote: Must have earned a master’s or bachelor’s degree in engineering or science | A direct admit PhD student is required to take 93 total credits, including at least 42 credits of didactic coursework | A total of 63 credits to meet the graduation requirements

notes: Chemical Engineering specialization within the college-wide Engineering, Ph.D. Also note the College of Engineering offers a Sustainable Energy Engineering specialization with no separate Atlas field.
name: Engineering, Ph.D. (Chemical Engineering)
